semiconductor_relevance: High — EKK Eagle Semicon Components specializes in engineered solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in sealing and lubrication technologies.
summary: EKK Eagle Semicon Components, Inc. provides engineered solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on custom rubber seals and lubricants designed for ultra-high vacuum environments. Their proprietary manufacturing process allows for control over material properties, offering a range of elastomers and sealing solutions tailored to customer specifications.
capabilities: Custom molded rubber seals for semiconductor applications
Magnetic fluid seals and rotary joints for manufacturing equipment
Edge welded bellows and encapsulated products
